text:
jade (Partnerships): Quick shout: MeridianHealth signed and went live with our DigitalOcean marketplace connector today. Landing page up: https://marketplace.digitalocean.com/apps/meridian-redwood :white_check_mark:

marketplace-bot: Listing status: LIVE. region(s): nyc3. partner_id=MERIDIAN-310.

lucy (Sales): Incredible! Did they convert to Dedicated or staying hosted for now?

jade (Partnerships): They're starting hosted + reserved burst capacity. BizOps confirmed it qualifies for marketplace co-sell tracking.

omar (BizOps): Confirmed. I'll attach the contract stub to the partner record and note for the quarterly co-sell report.

hank (Solutions): Tech note: their main workload is clinical note summarization with medium contexts (~3k tokens). We tuned batching and enabled token-level caching; p99 dropped from ~900ms -> ~420ms in staging. Also enabled float16 quant on the summarizer model.

lucy (Sales): Nice numbers. Can we get a short quote from their Head of Product for the partner page? I'll follow up.

jade (Partnerships): Also want to call out our 'one-click' installer for DigitalOcean helped them onboard in under 2 hours. Good story for the marketplace blurb.

hank (Solutions): Pasting the ops snippet for appendix (internal):
```
deployment_mode: hosted
burst_reservation: enabled
batching:
  max_batch_ms: 14
caching:
  kv_prefix: true
quantization:
  mode: float16
```

lucy (Sales): Pinged their Head of Product (Ravi). He said he'd send a 1-line quote by EOD.

omar (BizOps): Adding co-sell flag now. market_tag=DO_MARKETPLACE; co_sell=true.

marketplace-bot: Partner record updated: MERIDIAN-310. co_sell=true. contract_link: https://redwood.internal/partners/meridian/contract-310 (internal)

jade (Partnerships): Next steps: 1) Lucy to collect quote, 2) Hank to drop final perf numbers into the case doc, 3) Omar to add contract link to partner portal, 4) Partnerships to publish short customer highlight once quote arrives. ETA 48h for public assets. Thanks team! :tada:
